name: Grand Ball
note: Selfie: Replace the streaky mirror reflections on the floor with smooth, softly polished honey wood that has one gentle, blurred reflection under the dancers. Make the green curtains slightly lighter and softer. Keep the sheep, the cow, the bow, the bonnet and the view.

name: Barn Detectives
note: Shopping: Replace the strand-by-strand straw floor with a smooth golden straw mat with a few large, soft clumps. Paint the barn wall a slightly more muted dusty red with a few broad, plain boards. Keep the sheep, the cow, the milk can, the notepad and the view.
